notes: Curated Amazon product network for PlantAdvocate. Each product is a tightly-scoped Amazon SEARCH (never a pinned ASIN), so entries cannot go stale when a listing disappears. `match` rules are evaluated against the tag set derived from a species' own catalog record (see app/services/plant_profile.py) — nothing here is keyed to a hand-maintained per-species list, so every species in the catalog (curated and expansion-sourced alike) resolves to recommendations. `grounded_on` names the species fields that justify the recommendation; the API returns it so the UI can show WHY a product was suggested, the same grounding discipline the advisor uses.

products.title: Cactus & succulent potting mix
products.keywords: cactus succulent potting mix fast draining
products.why: This species is listed for a fast-draining cactus/succulent mix — ordinary potting soil holds far too much water and is the usual cause of rot here.

products.title: Perlite (drainage amendment)
products.keywords: horticultural perlite coarse potting soil amendment
products.why: Cut into any bagged mix to open it up. The care record for this plant calls for extra drainage.

products.title: Chunky aroid mix (bark, perlite, coco coir)
products.keywords: chunky aroid potting mix orchid bark perlite coco coir monstera philodendron
products.why: Aroid roots need air pockets between waterings; the bark-and-perlite structure is what keeps this species' roots from sitting wet.

products.title: Orchid bark potting medium
products.keywords: orchid bark potting medium phalaenopsis fir bark
products.why: This is an epiphyte — its roots grow in air on bark, not in soil. Packing it into potting mix suffocates the roots.

products.title: Sphagnum moss
products.keywords: sphagnum moss long fiber horticultural
products.why: Holds moisture at the roots without going dense — useful for a species that wants steady moisture and high humidity.

products.title: Moisture-retentive indoor potting mix
products.keywords: indoor potting mix moisture control peat coir houseplant
products.why: This species is listed for a moisture-retentive mix — it should never dry out completely between waterings.

products.title: All-purpose indoor potting mix
products.keywords: indoor houseplant potting mix all purpose well draining
products.why: A standard well-draining houseplant mix is what this species' record calls for — no special amendment needed.

products.title: Acidic soil mix for acid-loving plants
products.keywords: acidic potting soil azalea camellia blueberry acid loving
products.why: This plant needs genuinely acidic soil — in neutral soil it can't take up iron and the leaves yellow between the veins.

products.title: Soil acidifier (elemental sulfur)
products.keywords: soil acidifier elemental sulfur lower soil ph
products.why: Drops soil pH into the acidic range this species requires, and keeps it there as tap water pushes it back up.

products.title: Raised bed / garden soil
products.keywords: raised bed garden soil organic vegetable
products.why: An outdoor grower — bed or large-container soil, not indoor potting mix, is the right base for this one.

products.title: Organic compost / soil conditioner
products.keywords: organic compost soil conditioner garden amendment
products.why: Rich, fertile soil is what this species' record asks for; compost supplies it plus the structure a heavy feeder wants.

products.title: Garden mulch (straw or bark)
products.keywords: garden mulch straw bark natural weed suppression
products.why: Evens out soil moisture outdoors — worth it for a plant whose record warns about inconsistent watering.

products.title: Balanced liquid houseplant fertilizer
products.keywords: balanced liquid houseplant fertilizer indoor plant food
products.why: Matches the balanced feeding this species' fertilize schedule describes, and liquid feed is easy to dilute to the half-strength many entries call for.

products.title: High-nitrogen fertilizer for fast growers
products.keywords: high nitrogen liquid fertilizer foliage plant food
products.why: This species feeds on a short interval during the growing season — a heavy feeder by its own schedule.

products.title: Cactus & succulent fertilizer
products.keywords: cactus succulent fertilizer low nitrogen plant food
products.why: A very light feeder — regular houseplant food at full strength burns the roots of a plant on this schedule.

products.title: Orchid fertilizer
products.keywords: orchid fertilizer bloom booster urea free
products.why: Bark medium holds no nutrients at all, so orchids depend entirely on what you feed them.

products.title: Acid-loving plant fertilizer
products.keywords: acid loving plant fertilizer azalea holly blueberry
products.why: Formulated to feed without pushing soil pH up out of the acidic range this species needs.

products.title: Vegetable & tomato fertilizer
products.keywords: tomato vegetable garden fertilizer organic
products.why: Fruiting vegetables need phosphorus and potassium at flowering, not the nitrogen that grows leaves at the expense of fruit.

products.title: Bloom-boosting fertilizer
products.keywords: bloom booster flower fertilizer high phosphorus
products.why: For a plant grown for its flowers, a higher-phosphorus feed during budding gives more bloom per plant.

products.title: Slow-release granular plant food
products.keywords: slow release granular fertilizer plant food outdoor
products.why: One application covers most of the season — easier to keep on schedule than remembering a liquid feed every few weeks.

products.title: Gentle organic fertilizer for herbs
products.keywords: organic herb fertilizer gentle plant food edible
products.why: Herbs grown for flavor do better on a light, organic feed — over-fertilized herbs grow fast and taste of almost nothing.

products.title: Terracotta pots with drainage holes
products.keywords: terracotta clay pots drainage holes saucer
products.why: Unglazed clay breathes and pulls water out of the mix — the right pot for a species that must dry out between waterings.

products.title: Nursery pots with drainage
products.keywords: plastic nursery pots drainage holes plant pots with saucer
products.why: Holds moisture more evenly than clay, which suits a species that wants its mix to stay damp.

products.title: Slotted clear orchid pots
products.keywords: clear orchid pot slotted drainage phalaenopsis
products.why: Orchid roots photosynthesize and need airflow; the clear wall also lets you see root health and moisture without unpotting.

products.title: Large floor planter with drainage
products.keywords: large indoor planter pot drainage hole floor plant
products.why: This species gets tall enough that it will outgrow a tabletop pot and start tipping.

products.title: Fabric grow bags
products.keywords: fabric grow bags with handles vegetable planting
products.why: Air-prunes the roots and drains freely — a good container answer for growing this outdoors without a bed.

products.title: Plant saucers / drip trays
products.keywords: plant saucer drip tray clear plastic pot trays
products.why: Catches the runoff you want when watering thoroughly — as long as you tip out what's left, so the roots aren't standing in it.

products.title: Repotting mat / tarp
products.keywords: repotting mat waterproof gardening tarp indoor
products.why: This species is on a regular repotting schedule; a mat makes it a kitchen-table job instead of a cleanup.

products.title: Long-spout indoor watering can
products.keywords: long spout indoor watering can houseplant
products.why: Puts water at the soil instead of on the crown and leaves — which matters for the species whose records warn about rot or leaf spotting.

products.title: Bottom-watering trays
products.keywords: bottom watering tray plant self watering tray
products.why: Lets the mix wick water up evenly — the gentlest option for a species that wants steady moisture but hates a wet crown.

products.title: Water filter pitcher
products.keywords: water filter pitcher
products.why: This species' record specifically flags sensitivity to tap water — filtered or distilled water prevents the brown, crispy tips.

products.title: Self-watering spikes / globes
products.keywords: self watering spikes globes plant vacation
products.why: Covers the gap for a plant on a short watering interval when you're away.

products.title: Watering wand / garden hose nozzle
products.keywords: watering wand garden hose nozzle gentle shower
products.why: A gentle shower head waters an outdoor planting deeply without blasting soil off the roots.

products.title: Soaker hose / drip irrigation kit
products.keywords: soaker hose drip irrigation kit garden bed
products.why: Even moisture at the root zone is exactly what this plant's record asks for, and drip keeps the foliage dry, which cuts fungal disease.

products.title: Bypass pruning shears
products.keywords: bypass pruning shears garden pruners sharp
products.why: This species is on a regular pruning schedule; a clean bypass cut heals far better than the crush a cheap anvil pruner leaves.

products.title: Precision micro snips
products.keywords: micro tip pruning snips precision garden scissors
products.why: For deadheading and fine trimming on small, soft growth where full-size pruners do more harm than good.

products.title: Hand trowel & transplanting set
products.keywords: garden hand trowel transplanter tool set stainless
products.why: The basic planting and repotting tools this species' schedule will have you reaching for.

products.title: Gardening gloves
products.keywords: gardening gloves breathable nitrile coated
products.why: This species is listed as toxic — its sap is a skin and eye irritant, so handle it with gloves when pruning or repotting.

products.title: Microfiber cloths for leaf cleaning
products.keywords: microfiber cleaning cloths soft lint free
products.why: This species has a leaf-cleaning schedule — dust on broad leaves measurably cuts the light reaching them.

products.title: Plant labels & marker
products.keywords: plant labels garden markers waterproof
products.why: Sowings and cuttings look identical for weeks; labels are the difference between a record and a guess.

products.title: Harvest basket / colander
products.keywords: garden harvest basket colander vegetable
products.why: For an edible crop, somewhere to put the harvest that lets you rinse and drain in one step.

products.title: Moss pole / coir climbing pole
products.keywords: moss pole coir plant support climbing monstera philodendron
products.why: This is a climber — given something to attach to, its aerial roots grip and the leaves mature larger than they ever do trailing.

products.title: Indoor plant trellis
products.keywords: indoor plant trellis small pot support arch
products.why: Gives a vining houseplant a shape to grow into instead of trailing off the shelf.

products.title: Plant stakes & soft plant ties
products.keywords: plant stakes garden ties soft velcro support
products.why: This species gets tall enough to lean or snap in wind once it's carrying weight up top.

products.title: Tomato cages / heavy-duty plant cages
products.keywords: tomato cage heavy duty plant support garden
products.why: A fruiting plant this size will pull itself over once it's loaded; cage it before it needs it, not after.

products.title: Garden trellis / netting
products.keywords: garden trellis netting climbing vegetable pea bean
products.why: A vining outdoor crop yields more per square foot grown up than sprawling across the ground, and stays cleaner and less disease-prone.

products.title: Cool-mist room humidifier
products.keywords: cool mist humidifier room quiet
products.why: This species wants humidity most homes never reach — a humidifier is the only reliable way to hold that range, and it works far better than misting.

products.title: Pebble humidity tray
products.keywords: humidity tray pebble plant tray indoor
products.why: A modest local humidity bump for a plant that likes it damper than the room, without running an appliance.

products.title: Plant mister / spray bottle
products.keywords: plant mister spray bottle fine mist
products.why: This species has a misting schedule of its own; a fine-mist bottle beats a jet that soaks the leaves.

products.title: Frost cloth / plant cover
products.keywords: frost cloth plant cover freeze protection garden
products.why: This species' minimum temperature is above freezing — one unexpected frost ends it, and a cover buys the nights at the edges of the season.

products.title: Full-spectrum grow light bulb
products.keywords: full spectrum grow light bulb led e26 plant
products.why: Screws into a normal lamp. Enough for a single plant that wants bright light through a winter or in a dim room.

products.title: Full-spectrum LED grow light panel
products.keywords: led grow light panel full spectrum indoor plants timer
products.why: This species wants direct sun. Indoors — or out of season — that's more light than a window gives, and a panel is the honest substitute.

products.title: Seed-starting grow light with stand
products.keywords: seed starting grow light stand adjustable seedlings
products.why: Seedlings started on a windowsill stretch and flop; light directly overhead is what keeps them stocky.

products.title: Outlet timer for grow lights
products.keywords: outlet timer plug in programmable grow light
products.why: Plants respond to consistent day length; a timer removes the part of that you'd otherwise have to remember.

products.title: Neem oil concentrate
products.keywords: neem oil concentrate plant spray organic
products.why: The broad first response to most soft-bodied houseplant pests, and safe on edibles up to harvest.

products.title: Insecticidal soap spray
products.keywords: insecticidal soap plant spray ready to use
products.why: Gentler than neem on thin or fuzzy leaves, and the standard treatment for aphids, mites and mealybugs indoors.

products.title: Yellow sticky traps
products.keywords: yellow sticky traps fungus gnats indoor plants
products.why: Catches fungus gnats, which show up wherever the top of the mix stays damp — likely for a species on a short watering interval.

products.title: Pet-safe plant pest spray
products.keywords: pet safe plant insect spray non toxic indoor
products.why: This species is already toxic to pets. If it lives with animals, don't add a second hazard on the leaf surface.

products.title: Slug & snail bait (iron phosphate)
products.keywords: slug snail bait iron phosphate pet safe garden
products.why: Slugs go for exactly this kind of soft outdoor foliage; the iron-phosphate baits work without the pet risk of metaldehyde.

products.title: Floating row cover / insect netting
products.keywords: floating row cover insect netting garden crop protection
products.why: A physical barrier is the only thing that reliably stops cabbage moths and beetles, and it needs no spray at all.

products.title: Copper fungicide
products.keywords: copper fungicide garden plant disease spray
products.why: Humid conditions plus dense foliage is how leaf-spot and blight get started on this kind of crop.

products.title: Seed starting trays with humidity dome
products.keywords: seed starting tray humidity dome cell trays
products.why: This species is started from seed indoors ahead of the season — a domed tray holds the warmth and moisture germination needs.

products.title: Seed starting mix
products.keywords: seed starting mix germination fine potting
products.why: A fine, sterile mix — potting soil is too coarse and too rich for germinating seed.

products.title: Seedling heat mat
products.keywords: seedling heat mat germination warming thermostat
products.why: This species' record names a soil temperature for germination that indoor air alone won't hold.

products.title: Rooting hormone
products.keywords: rooting hormone powder gel plant cuttings propagation
products.why: This species propagates from cuttings; rooting hormone raises the strike rate and shortens the wait.

products.title: Propagation station (rooting vases)
products.keywords: propagation station glass vases plant cuttings rooting
products.why: Cuttings from this species root in water, where you can watch the roots develop before potting them up.

products.title: Soil moisture meter
products.keywords: soil moisture meter plant hygrometer probe
products.why: Overwatering is the top killer for a species on a long watering interval — a probe reads the root zone instead of the surface, which dries first and lies.

products.title: Digital hygrometer / thermometer
products.keywords: digital hygrometer thermometer indoor humidity monitor
products.why: This species has a specific humidity and temperature range in its record; a $10 meter tells you whether the spot you picked actually meets it.

products.title: Light meter for plants
products.keywords: light meter plants lux foot candle indoor
products.why: "Bright indirect" is the vaguest instruction in plant care. A meter converts it to a number you can actually place a pot by.

products.title: Soil pH test kit
products.keywords: soil ph test kit garden meter
products.why: This species' soil requirement is stated as a pH range — the only way to know you're in it is to measure.

products.title: Soil thermometer
products.keywords: soil thermometer garden compost planting temperature
products.why: Transplanting and sowing dates for this species are given in soil temperature, not calendar dates.

plants.name: Basil
plants.why: The classic tomato neighbor — shares the same water and sun needs and is widely grown to deter thrips and hornworms.

plants.name: Marigold
plants.why: Planted along tomato and pepper rows for root-knot nematode suppression.

plants.name: Nasturtium
plants.why: Draws aphids away from the crop and can be pulled once it's covered in them.

plants.name: Dill
plants.why: Its flowers feed the parasitic wasps that control cabbage worm.

plants.name: Nasturtium
plants.why: A trap crop — cabbage moths lay on it in preference to the brassica.

plants.name: Thyme
plants.why: Aromatic groundcover that masks the scent brassica pests home in on.

plants.name: Sunflower
plants.why: Pulls in the pollinators squash and cucumber flowers depend on, and gives vines something to climb.

plants.name: Marigold
plants.why: Commonly interplanted for cucumber beetle deterrence.

plants.name: Borage
plants.why: One of the strongest bee draws you can plant, which directly raises fruit set.

plants.name: Carrots
plants.why: The reciprocal pairing — alliums confuse carrot fly, carrots confuse onion fly.

plants.name: Chamomile
plants.why: A traditional allium companion, planted for bulb size and flavor.

plants.name: Onions
plants.why: Interplanted with root crops to break up the scent trail carrot fly follows.

plants.name: Radish
plants.why: Fast enough to mark the row and be harvested before the slower root crop needs the space.

plants.name: Sweet Corn
plants.why: The Three Sisters pairing — corn is the pole, beans put back the nitrogen corn takes.

plants.name: Squash
plants.why: Third of the Three Sisters: broad leaves shade the soil and hold moisture.

plants.name: Borage
plants.why: Strawberry growers plant it for pollination and reported fruit quality.

plants.name: Chives
plants.why: Ringed around berries and fruit for its reputation against aphids and mildew.

plants.name: Oregano
plants.why: Same sun, same lean soil, same watering — herbs of this type share a pot happily.

plants.name: Thyme
plants.why: Another dry-side Mediterranean herb; grouping them means one watering rhythm, not three.

plants.name: Sweet Alyssum
plants.why: Low, long-blooming edging that feeds hoverflies — the aphid predators worth having nearby.

plants.name: Zinnia
plants.why: Pollinator magnet with a long cutting season; easy from direct sowing.

plants.name: Pothos
plants.why: Tolerates the same indoor light range with far less fuss — a good shelf-mate while you learn a harder plant.

plants.name: Snake Plant
plants.why: Thrives in the same rooms, on a completely different watering interval, so a missed week costs nothing.
